description.description: One line on what the skill does and when to use it; it is listed so later runs can find it.

name.description: Skill name: lowercase words joined by hyphens, naming the job (e.g. test-failures, package-exports).

code.description: TypeScript for one job: the body of an async function that reads `input`, calls tools as `await external_<tool name>(input)` and returns a small JSON value.

input.description: JSON Schema of `input`, of type "object"; every run is checked against it. Omit when the skill takes no input.

network.description: The only hosts the script may connect to, exactly as it needs them (e.g. "registry.npmjs.org", "*.github.com", "api.example.com:443"). Omit for no network; localhost only if listed.

script.description: POSIX sh script for one job, run in the working directory with arguments as $1, $2, …. Print only what the task needs: filter or cap noisy output in the script.

program.description: ts for work done with your tools (reading, changing and checking files, combining results, running sh skills); sh only for host commands no tool runs: builds, tests, git, package managers.

reason.description: One sentence on why, shown to the user when asking.

usage.description: What the input or arguments mean and what the result shows.
